title: A superposition reduces on average after $\tau \approx \hbar / E_G$

statements.text: In the Diósi-Penrose scheme, a superposition of two mass distributions reduces to one of them after a time τ ≈ ħ/E_G on average, randomly like a half-life in radioactive decay.
In the Diósi-Penrose scheme, a superposition of two mass distributions reduces to one of them after a time $\tau \approx \hbar / E_G$ on average, randomly like a half-life in radioactive decay.

sources.quote: the superposition reduces to one of the alternatives in a timescale τ that can be estimated (for a superposition of two states each of which is assumed to be taken to be stationary on its own) according to the formula τ ≈ h̄/EG
